discrepancies.pems_original: PEMS full text contains general restraint guidelines and chemical restraint notes.
discrepancies.converted_text: The Poquoson protocol adds extensive, highly specific drug dosing tables for chemical restraint that are not present in the PEMS source file.
discrepancies.recommendation: Review these chemical restraint dosages against the Poquoson OMD's standing orders. If they are Poquoson-specific, this needs to be clearly indicated as a local modification, as it exceeds the base PEMS protocol provided.
